notes.title: Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hi Treasure Hunters![/b][/h1]

As always, we are [b]grateful[/b] for your reviews. Thanks to your [b]opinions and suggestions[/b], we’re able to [b]improve our game[/b] and solve problems [b]for you[/b]!

[h3][b]Keep them coming![/b][/h3]

Today, we’re excited to announce the [b]Next Update[/b] for [b]My Museum: Treasure Hunter[/b]. We hope these changes will enhance your adventure and make your experience even better!

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved lighting in Egypt
[*] Changes to missions sequence in Egypt
[*] Small fixes to saving missions in Egypt
[*] Fixed an issue where you can encounter a blocker on the tutorial mission with trash bags
[*] Fixed an issue where you can encounter a blocker while clicking on the computer
[*] Fixed an issue where your game paused while using the exhibition menu
[*] Fixed the indicator on the hook (mummy room in Egypt)
[*] Fixed an issue where you could fall off from Egypt because the landscape disappeared
[/list]

[h3][b]IMPORTANT!
For anyone having troubles with the game, especially if you played earlier playtest/demo or prologue versions. It is possible that the problem is related to the game save files from earlier versions. Try deleting the /Appdata/Local/MyMuseum/Saved folder. [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1833710/My_Museum_Treasure_Hunter/

notes.title: Devlog #8 Treasure Hunter`s Journal - My Museum: Treasure hunter🤠
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome treasure hunters 🤠[/h1]
[h3]In the next [b]My Museum: Treasure Hunter[/b]🧭devlog[/h3]
We want to show you, a new very useful feature as [b]Journal📔[/b], thanks to which no longer any [b]challenge[/b] will be beyond your strength and the [b]memories[/b] of your expeditions🧳 will remain for you and your [b]successors[/b]

[b]You can use the journal in two main ways[/b]
[list]
[*] Journal as diary 📔🖼️
[*] Diary as a guidebook 🧩🧾
[/list]
See for yourself 👀...

[b]1. Journal as diary 📔🖼️[/b]
Every traveler visiting the farthest corners of the world and exploring places no one has yet reached must have a [b]journal[/b]🧾. His memories, experiences and [b]discoveries[/b] are worth their weight in gold💰, they should be written down and preserved for [b]future generations[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/216252bdccb7eed5c51c979d96f9610520957a48.png[/img]

[b] 2. A useful diary as a guidebook 🧩🧾[/b]
This is a very important element that will help players at times when they get stuck and can't cope with the puzzles to solve. It is also in response to feedback from players. Those who prefer bigger challenges⚡️ won't have as many prompts in the visible UI. More casual players🎮, on the other hand, will be able to use the hints in the guidebook at any time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/b144bbc503d34a572922c4344f5bad7e1175e32c.png[/img]

PSSSST In below video you can find [b]bonus➕[/b] there are some shots from the [b]new expedition[/b], more information coming soon 🔜

notes.title: My Museum: Treasure Hunter Demo

My Museum is a educational FPV simulator designed for fans of renovation, management and history buffs! You can find there astounding renovation mechanics, enhanced economy and loads of historical facts!
Great fun for the whole family!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/6e3734ece48406cceafb992f782b58112fbf9c56.png[/img]

- hire staff and manage the business
- collect old and damaged artefacts

- create the best exhibition
- organise auctions and earn
- become the largest art institution

notes.title: Devlog #6 Change of name - My Museum: Treasure hunter
notes.notes:
[b][h2]New name My Museum: Treasure Hunter[/h2][/b]
We decided to change the name, specifically to add the expansion Treasure Hunter 🤠 to the name 🔥.


Why did we decide to do it?
Because the game has evolved a lot from the creation of the Steam card until now. This was influenced by the creative process of our team, but before all the feedback from players we received after the release of the playtest version, the demo, the prologue 


In a post-playtest survey, the community found that you had the most fun with expeditions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/f95a2114b6b32c8f2801bb009b31dd17bca52f02.png[/img]

our game in addition to the original concept of restoring objects, museum building 🏛️ and creating exhibitions has gained the opportunity, to play the role of treasure hunter and obtain objects in remote and interesting corners of the world. 


[h2]Now you can explore[/h2]

[h3]Egyptian Pyramid🏜️ [/h3] There you will have to solve puzzles, search a mysterious tomb and obtain precious artifacts👑. This locations you might have already seen during testing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/1643b006d7dd8c15375e409800d48edbf35fae7d.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=aQEij6U7ZlE;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Forest 🌳 and WW2 Bunker🧱[/h3] this expedition is divided into two main tasks.... 

[b]Forest[/b] - Forest, in which you will have to find the hidden entrance to the bunker. But before that, together with your friend Arti 🐕 you will be able to search for treasures using metal detector🦯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/5448eda236e1eb04cd509b118a707120ed7ca1cb.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=4nWlvxQ5ewo;full][/previewyoutube] 

[b]Bunker[/b] - The first task will be to find the entrance to the bunker itself. Then exploring its underground part🕸️, which will not be that easy at all. There, too, you can expect puzzles and surprises as you search to find more artifacts. PS there you can expect explosions   💣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/1e344207a7f0a393ea6cd97240a1db521da869e8.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=bDLKTUlVN1U;full][/previewyoutube] 


[h3]Aztec ruins🌵🌴[/h3] this is our little surprise, you will have to wait for more information....😎🕵️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/da662972797dadc8f2e58d6b13e803bca8fcd824.png[/img]

notes.title: DevLog #5 - New tools and exhibitions 🏛️
notes.notes:
[h1]In another Devlog`s[b] My Museum[/b] you will be able to find new tools and thematic exhibitions. Make use of them in your museum 🏛️.[/h1]

[h1]New tools[/h1] 
[b]Cyclinator [/b]- we have added a great element to the renovation of the museum building, it is a sanding machine that breathes new life into the wooden parquet. Which will help achieve a beautiful effect, as well as give you the fun of restoring old things. This type of feautre are especially popular and liked in simulator games. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/c5df3bd12ceecf3cb150a1563dd2e4f6507b1000.png[/img]

[h1]New exibition[/h1]
[b]Exitibiotn[/b] - one of the most important elements of any museum is the exhibition. It's up to you to decide how you set up the showcases, as well as what subject matter you want to show the exhibition. Just remember that this will affect the evaluation of your work and the satisfaction or lack thereof of your visitors

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/837cae0f2e16c93e5ff640f7b5981463cd32804f.png[/img]

notes.title: 🥳 Great News for all My Museum funs 🏛️
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello [b]My Museum[/b] funs :)[/h1]
Thank you for participating in the Playtests👏, and for filling out the surveys. Your votes will not go in vain. Expeditions received the most votes for the most expect game expansion in February. As you expected, we added it to the game, it is the Ancient Pyramid of Egypt🏜️, and as it turned out, it was a shot in the arm, as this element of the game was the best rated during the last Playtest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/f95a2114b6b32c8f2801bb009b31dd17bca52f02.png[/img]

What's more, we gave you a choice of what places the next expedition would go to. The winner in this category was a World War II bunker. 🥳 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41610294/6c2673f8deabf512aecd8b9134c5983104c57841.png[/img]

It is the bunker that will appear as another place of exploration, it will be a mysterious location containing interesting puzzles and artifacts that we will acquire for our museum.
We have prepared for you a short video from the bunker.
